how_it_was_reached: dino-autofocus was accepted as a source by the person on 2026-10-03 (plan.md 10.2). Its merge-planning work drafted nineteen one-sentence definitions in docs/librarian-handoff.md section 6 at a1b7cac, on branch merge-plan/L-05-definitions-draft; the person told this seat directly to take them. This seat read the draft as data and ruled each sentence against the file it cites, read with git show at the pinned commit, never against the draft's wording alone. The LF-normalised body sha256 recomputed here matches the draft's.
publication: NOT PUBLIC WHEN READ. The repository is public, but on 2026-10-04 the pinned commit was on no pushed branch: the raw URL returned 404 and GitHub's commit API 422, and origin/main was 402c3b7. It sat on local merge-plan branches of the person's working copy. The url below resolves once the commit is pushed; until then the commit and body hash are what identify the content. PUBLISHED LATER THE SAME DAY: the person pushed merge-plan/L-05-definitions-draft on 2026-10-04, and this seat then fetched the file from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit; its LF-normalised sha256 matched body_sha256. The url now resolves.
